name: rhythmix-capacitor
description: Capacitor shell that bundles the RHYTHMIX static site as a native iOS/Android app.

scripts.sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync
scripts.ios:add: npm install @capacitor/ios && npx cap add ios
scripts.android:add: npm install @capacitor/android && npx cap add android
scripts.ios:run: npm run sync && npx cap run ios
scripts.android:run: npm run sync && npx cap run android
